cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace');sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp')
from wire import *
from harness import run
from canonref import hdr
def vw(val,width):return (([1,2,4,8].index(width)<<(8*width-2))|val).to_bytes(width,'big')
cases=[]
# pad/ping
cases.append(('00','I',b'\x00\x00\x01\x01',b'\x00\x00\x01\x01'))
# ack, ack ecn
raw=b'\x02'+vw(9,2)+vw(2,4)+vw(1,8)+vw(3,2)+vw(1,4)+vw(2,8)
can=b'\x02'+v(9)+v(2)+v(1)+v(3)+v(1)+v(2)
cases.append(('ack','I',raw,can))
# first=3 largest9 => [6,9], low6, gap1 => high3, range2 => new[1,3]
raw=b'\x03'+vw(9,2)+vw(2,4)+vw(1,8)+vw(3,2)+vw(1,4)+vw(2,8)+vw(7,2)+vw(8,4)+vw(9,8)
can=b'\x03'+v(9)+v(2)+v(1)+v(3)+v(1)+v(2)+v(7)+v(8)+v(9)
cases.append(('ackecn','I',raw,can))
# reset
raw=b'\x04'+vw(0,2)+vw(7,4)+vw(5,8);can=b'\x04'+v(0)+v(7)+v(5);cases.append(('reset','A',raw,can))
# stop
raw=b'\x05'+vw(0,2)+vw(7,4);can=b'\x05'+v(0)+v(7);cases.append(('stop','A',raw,can))
# crypto
raw=b'\x06'+vw(2,2)+vw(3,4)+b'abc';can=b'\x06'+v(2)+v(3)+b'abc';cases.append(('crypto','I',raw,can))
# stream variants
for t in range(8,16):
 raw=bytes([t])+vw(0,2)
 can=bytes([t])+v(0)
 if t&4:
  raw+=vw(2,4);can+=v(2)
 if t&2:
  raw+=vw(3,8)+b'abc';can+=v(3)+b'abc'
 else:
  raw+=b'abc';can+=b'abc'
 cases.append((f'stream{t:02x}','A',raw,can))
# maxdata
raw=b'\x10'+vw(10,2);can=b'\x10'+v(10);cases.append(('maxdata','A',raw,can))
# maxsd
raw=b'\x11'+vw(0,2)+vw(10,8);can=b'\x11'+v(0)+v(10);cases.append(('maxsd','A',raw,can))
# max streams
for t in [0x12,0x13]:
 raw=bytes([t])+vw(10,2);can=bytes([t])+v(10);cases.append((f'maxs{t:02x}','A',raw,can))
# db, sdb, sb
raw=b'\x14'+vw(10,2);can=b'\x14'+v(10);cases.append(('db','A',raw,can))
raw=b'\x15'+vw(0,2)+vw(10,4);can=b'\x15'+v(0)+v(10);cases.append(('sdb','A',raw,can))
for t in [0x16,0x17]:
 raw=bytes([t])+vw(10,2);can=bytes([t])+v(10);cases.append((f'sb{t:02x}','A',raw,can))
# nci
cid=b'xy';tok=bytes(range(16))
raw=b'\x18'+vw(1,2)+vw(0,4)+b'\x02'+cid+tok;can=b'\x18'+v(1)+v(0)+b'\x02'+cid+tok;cases.append(('nci','A',raw,can))
# retire dest bb seq0
raw=b'\x19'+vw(0,2);can=b'\x19'+v(0);cases.append(('retire','A',raw,can))
# path
p=bytes(range(8));raw=b'\x1a'+p;can=b'\x1a'+p;cases.append(('path','A',raw,can))
p=bytes(range(8,16));raw=b'\x1b'+p;can=b'\x1b'+p;cases.append(('resp','A',raw,can))
# close transport
raw=b'\x1c'+vw(7,2)+vw(1,4)+vw(3,8)+b'bye';can=b'\x1c'+v(7)+v(1)+v(3)+b'bye';cases.append(('close','I',raw,can))
# app close
raw=b'\x1d'+vw(7,2)+vw(3,8)+b'bye';can=b'\x1d'+v(7)+v(3)+b'bye';cases.append(('appclose','A',raw,can))
# dg30/31
raw=b'\x30abc';can=b'\x30abc';cases.append(('dg30','A',raw,can))
raw=b'\x31'+vw(3,4)+b'abc';can=b'\x31'+v(3)+b'abc';cases.append(('dg31','A',raw,can))
traces=[];meta=[]
for name,level,raw,can in cases:
 ev=[{'keys':['I','H','A']},datagram(envelope(level,0,raw,cid=b'\xbb'),(0,))]
 traces.append(trace(ev,local_cids=('aa','bb')));meta.append((name,level,can))
# 30 cases <=64
R=run(traces)
for (name,level,can),r in zip(meta,R['traces']):
 p=r['packets'][0];exp=hdr(level,0,0,can,cid=b'\xbb')
 ok=p['status'] in ('OK','PEER_CLOSE') and p['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(exp).hexdigest()
 print(name,p['status'],'OKHASH' if ok else 'BAD', '' if ok else (p.get('sha256'),hashlib.sha256(exp).hexdigest()))
